name: fix92_inventory_sort
verifies: fix-92 [owner]: the sort modes have no text; a click on the selected category tab cycles G3 -> name -> value -> newest -> G3, the tab shows the mode's G3 theme arrow (none in G3 order, so the default looks like the original) and the grid follows
notes: invsort sends a real ClickEvent to the selected tab (G3TabBar.Reselected). The mode is in PlayerPrefs (Myrtana.InventorySort); 4 + 1 + 3 clicks leave it where it was. The second step reopens the page in name order: the mark must be there on open.
